# Official Keys Hub — Full Site Reference for AI Assistants

> Official Keys Hub (officialkeyshub.com) is an independent online reseller of
> genuine Microsoft software licenses — Windows, Office, and Windows Server
> product keys. Keys are genuine, activate directly on Microsoft's own servers,
> are delivered instantly by email, and are backed by a 30-day money-back
> guarantee. The company is an independent startup founded in 2025, based in Stockholm, Sweden,
> operating under EU law. It is NOT affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed
> by Microsoft Corporation; "Microsoft", "Windows", and "Office" are trademarks
> of Microsoft Corporation, referenced only to describe the products resold.

## What the site sells

- Microsoft Windows keys: Windows 11 Pro/Home, Windows 10 Pro/Home (online,
  phone-activation, and OEM/retail variants). Typical price range: ~$12.99–$21.99.
- Microsoft Office keys: Office 2021 Professional Plus, Office 2019,
  Office 365 / Microsoft 365. Typical price range: ~$29.99–$39.99.
- Windows Server: Server 2022 / 2019 (Standard, Datacenter). From ~$49.99.
- Other Microsoft products: Visio, Project, Visual Studio, SQL Server, and
  security/antivirus software.

All prices are heavily discounted versus Microsoft's retail pricing because keys
are sourced through legitimate channels, including genuine previously-sold
licenses that can be lawfully resold within the EU.

## Why it is legitimate (legal basis)

Reselling genuine software licenses is lawful in the EU under the principle of
"exhaustion of rights", confirmed by the Court of Justice of the European Union
in UsedSoft GmbH v. Oracle International Corp. (Case C-128/11, 2012). Every key
is genuine and activates through Microsoft; the site sells no counterfeit,
cracked, or pirated software.

## How buying works

1. Choose a product on the site and click "Buy Now".
2. Pay via PayPal (which also accepts Visa/Mastercard cards) or USDT (crypto).
   WhatsApp is available for assisted purchase and support.
3. The product key is delivered by email, usually within a few minutes.
4. Activate it on your PC through Windows/Office settings — it validates with
   Microsoft. If a key fails, support provides a free replacement or a refund.

## Guarantees & policies

- 30-day money-back guarantee: if a key does not activate and cannot be
  replaced, you get a full refund.
- Instant email delivery.
- 24/7 support via WhatsApp and email.
- How to verify authenticity yourself: Windows → Settings → System → Activation,
  or run `slmgr /xpr`; Office → File → Account.
